```patch
replace CouponsRow
  row gap=2 {
    text item.name bold
    text `Descuento: ${item.amount}`
    button "Eliminar" danger small -> onRemove
  }
set CouponsRow onRemove: () => void = () => {}
replace CouponsPage/column/CouponsList
  CouponsList items=items onRemove=(id => items = items.filter(i => i.id != id))
set CouponsList onRemove: (id: Number) => void = () => {}
replace CouponsList/column/for/CouponsRow
  CouponsRow item=item onRemove=(() => onRemove(item.id))
```
